title: Senior Software Engineer at Phaidra
description_review: Senior software engineer position designing AI-powered control systems and autonomous reinforcement learning agents for industrial facilities. Focuses on converting sensor data into automated decisions and allowing domain experts to configure AI agents. Remote United States role with unstated salary.
pros: Autonomous AI agent design directly matches candidate's applied AI engineering focus
Senior engineering scope tackling complex industrial control systems and automation

pros: Multi-agent orchestration and production AI agent platform directly matches candidate's multi-agent background

title: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js) at Proxify

Key technologies include TypeScript, REST/GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Remote position operating in the CET (+/- 3 hours) time zone.
pros: Senior backend API and microservice architecture scope with 5+ years requirement
TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB align with candidate's secondary tech stack
Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and modular architectural design
cons: Centered on Node.js and Nest.js without Java or Spring Boot
Staffing network client engagement without enterprise modernization or banking focus

Senior-level ownership of high-availability cloud environments and CI/CD automation
